posts.body:
Not sure what too do or what my options are.

I'm just pregnant, and have a loan. I'm only entitled to statutory maternity pay. This will not be enough to cover my Loan and other bills. My loan has 29 payments left on it. I'm not sure what the best thing to do is. Does anyone have any advice please?

Concerned about this.

posts.body:
Seek help/advice from an organisation like National Debt line or CAB.

Is it early enough that you could recoup or surrender the money/finance ? I am sure something can be sorted if being pro active as you are. Even a priority debt can have a payment break and be re-packaged if steps are taken in time, those who stuggle to get credit cannot be refused where there is a need for the goods/service and actually become exempt from charges as all have to keep going - things are a lot different now so don't worry.

You can't pay ultimately what you don't have x

posts.body:
Definitely talk to the National Debt Helpline, they can help to get the ball rolling and help you sort out the agreement with the bank early enough so:

1. you do not worry when the time comes! Been there myself and cant stress enough how tough it can be when you have unsorted debts and a baby 

2. bank will not be that favourable if you leave it till the last minute

3. you are already in debt to the bank = you owe them money , so not too sure what are you referring to when you say you don't think you are in debt yet.

Best way is to deal with the looming issue instead of waiting. Saying that from my own very painful and costly experience in the past.
